metadata.transcription: Pachamamataqa chaninchana, imaraykuchus paymi kawsayninchis. Mana pay kaqtinqa, mana mikhuna, mana unu, mana samaypas kanmanchu. Wawakunaman yachachina, payta qhuyaspaqa, nuqanchis kikinchis kawsayninchistan qhuyapayashanchis.

segments.text: Mana pay kaqtinqa, mana mikhuna, mana unu, mana samaypas kanmanchu.
